about: The demo's pacing, read by src/demo.rs and walked by tests/demo_walk.rs. The demo is a new World's designed first session, played turn by turn as the full app plays it: its first sitting passes six World days and ends on the Goodnight card; the demo plays freely, so Sleep now begins the next sitting at once and the window opens on its morning card; that sitting's one day is the demo's last, and letting it pass shows the wishlist card at dusk. Beats name the pace they are measured at and when they must arrive, in seconds of play.

intended.about: A newcomer who reads what is said, answers every card, makes what their hands can, does the favours asked, has a word with someone and looks about a little each day.

answer_first.about: A player who goes straight to the cards: skims what is said as it is shown rather than waiting for it, skips the morning's news, takes the first answer to each card and lets the day pass.
